other_text: THOUSANDS OF YEARS AGO, IT DEVOURED THE ENTIRE LUNAR CIVILIZATION BEFORE BEING IMPRISONED BY THE LAST MOON WIZARDS. NOW, IT'S FREE... IT'S ON ITS WAY TO EARTH, AND IT'S STILL SUPER HUNGRY.
